_nota: EJEMPLO. Estructura de propuesta de servicios de diseño interior. Los honorarios son placeholders — reemplazar por la tarifa real antes de enviar.

cotizacion.notas_intro: Full-service interior design for the great room, dining room and three upper baths. Scope covers concept, material and FF&E selection, construction documentation, procurement management and site coordination through installation.

items.descripcion: Programming, site survey and concept direction
items.detalle: Client interview, existing conditions survey, two concept directions presented

items.descripcion: Space planning and preliminary floor plans
Material and finish selection, storyboards per room
items.detalle: Includes finish schedule with vendor links, per specialty (tile, plumbing, lighting, furniture)
Three views per room, up to two rounds of revisions included
Purchase orders, vendor coordination, freight tracking, damage claims

pagos.hito: Retainer on signature — applied to final invoice
Monthly through Phase 3, final upon installation

condiciones: Fees cover design services only. Furniture, fixtures, equipment, freight and installation labor are billed separately at cost plus the agreed procurement fee.
Two rounds of revisions per rendering are included. Additional rounds are billed hourly at the rate stated above.
Changes to approved scope, layout or specification after sign-off are billed as additional services.
Lead times quoted by vendors are estimates and are not guaranteed by the designer.
Natural materials carry inherent variation in color, vein and texture. Variation is not a defect.
Client approval on the finish schedule is required in writing before any purchase order is released.
Invoices are due within 15 days of issue. Work may pause on accounts past 30 days.
This proposal is valid for the period stated above.
